REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - FEBRUARY 4, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
4.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments may be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
5.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items. If a Commission member requests separate consideration, the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
5A.
Approval of Minutes
Special Meeting Minutes of January 14, 2026
6.
Public Hearings
6A.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE VESTING TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 84686 FOR A DEVELOPMENT PROPOSAL BY MELIA HOMES INC., TO CREATE THIRTY (30) FOR-SALE CONDOMINIUM UNITS ON A ±1.34-ACRE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 20223 CABRILLO LANE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 (APN 7055-017-002).*
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE PRECISE PLAN 2026-1 FOR A DEVELOPMENT PROPOSAL BY MELIA HOMES INC., TO DEMOLISH TWO (2) EXISTING COMMERCIAL BUILDINGS CONNECTED BY A SHARED ROOF AND CONSTRUCT THIRTY (30) ATTACHED THREE-STORY TOWNHOME DWELLING UNITS, INCLUDING THREE AFFORDABLE UNITS, WITHIN SIX (6) BUILDINGS. THE PROJECT ALSO INCLUDES OPEN SPACE AND RECREATION AREAS, PARKING, LANDSCAPING, AND ACCESS IMPROVEMENTS ON A ±1.34-ACRE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 20223 CABRILLO LANE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 (APN 7055-017-002).*
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE A REASSIGNMENT OF HOUSING UNITS BETWEEN SITE A AND SITE 7 WITHIN THE CITY'S 2021-2029 HOUSING ELEMENT, IN COMPLIANCE WITH HOUSING ELEMENT PROGRAM 9 AND NO NET LOSS PROVISIONS OF APPLICABLE HOUSING LAW.

PowerPoint
8.
Reports
8A.
Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison
During this part of the meeting, designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior meeting, including any request by members to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior meeting agenda.
8B.
Reports from Planning Commission Members
During this part of the meeting, members may provide brief reports to the community on various matters of interest, including any mandated reports required by AB 1234. Pursuant to the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act and the City of Cerritos Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy, there may be no discussion or action taken on any matters presented during this item or that are not listed on the meeting agenda.
9.
Adjournment

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Planning Commission Meeting
February 4, 2026
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Benjamin Ao
  Commissioner Kiritkumar Chauhan
  Commissioner Riaz Surti
  Vice Chair Deepak “DJ” Jhaveri
  Chair Jose “Armin” Reyes

PRESENT:  Assistant City Attorney Shukan Patel
  Deputy City Manager Ryan Carey
  Director of Administrative Services Drew Schneider
  Director of Community and Cultural Services Annie Hylton
  Director of Community Development Sabrina Chan
  Assistant City Engineer Jared Lee
  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña
  Communications and Marketing Manager Scott Harvey
  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda
  Associate Planner Mary Balderrama

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Surti.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to address the Planning
  Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

5.  Consent Calendar

5A.  Approval of Minutes

  Wednesday, January 14, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Special Meeting
  Minutes.

City of Cerritos  February 4, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Chauhan, and seconded by Commissioner
  Ao, to approve the Wednesday, January 14, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission
  Special Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (4-0-0-1) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  Jhaveri

6.  Public Hearings

6A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVE VESTING TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 84686 FOR A
  DEVELOPMENT PROPOSAL BY MELIA HOMES INC., TO CREATE THIRTY (30) FOR-
  SALE CONDOMINIUM UNITS ON A ±1.34-ACRE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 20223
  CABRILLO LANE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 (APN 7055-017-002).*

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVE PRECISE PLAN 2026-1 FOR A DEVELOPMENT PROPOSAL BY
  MELIA HOMES INC., TO DEMOLISH TWO (2) EXISTING COMMERCIAL BUILDINGS
  CONNECTED BY A SHARED ROOF AND CONSTRUCT THIRTY (30) ATTACHED THREE-
  STORY TOWNHOME DWELLING UNITS, INCLUDING THREE AFFORDABLE UNITS,
  WITHIN SIX (6) BUILDINGS. THE PROJECT ALSO INCLUDES OPEN SPACE AND
  RECREATION AREAS, PARKING, LANDSCAPING, AND ACCESS IMPROVEMENTS ON A
  ±1.34-ACRE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 20223 CABRILLO LANE, CERRITOS,
  CALIFORNIA, 90703 (APN 7055-017-002).*

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVE A REASSIGNMENT OF HOUSING UNITS BETWEEN SITE A AND
  SITE 7 WITHIN THE CITY’S 2021-2029 HOUSING ELEMENT, IN COMPLIANCE WITH
  HOUSING ELEMENT PROGRAM 9 AND NO NET LOSS PROVISIONS OF APPLICABLE
  HOUSING LAW.

  *Pursuant to Section 15332 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details about the proposed project and existing
  property conditions. Ms. Acuña continued providing details about the proposed
  development of thirty (30) for-sale townhome units, which will consist of six (6)
  buildings featuring 2 design styles, Building Type A and Building Type B and
  enhanced architectural detailing in a Contemporary architectural style. Building Type
  A includes four (4) dwelling units per building, each with an attached private garage,
  while Building Type B includes seven (7) dwelling units per building, also with
  attached private garages. The project includes a variety of floor plans designed to
  accommodate potential buyers' household needs. Ms. Acuña concluded her
  presentation by stating that two (2) comments were received in support regarding
  the proposed project.

City of Cerritos  February 4, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
   Discussion continued regarding the City’s art in public places program for affordable
  housing units, the estimated time frame for completing the proposed development,
  and clarification of “passive lawn” open space.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Project applicant Chad Brown provided
  comments on the design choice of all electrical utilities in the proposed development
  in lieu of natural gas, the market-rate pricing of the homes based on the floor plan,
  construction noise, infeasibility of a gated community, and the estimated timeframe
  for construction completion.

  Cerritos Resident Catherine Pascual provided comments in favor of the proposed
  development.

  Seeing and hearing no other speakers wishing to address the Planning Commission,
  Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Jhaveri and seconded by Commissioner
  Ao to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-5: A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVE VESTING TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 84686 FOR A
  DEVELOPMENT PROPOSAL BY MELIA HOMES INC., TO CREATE THIRTY (30) FOR-
  SALE CONDOMINIUM UNITS ON A ±1.34-ACRE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 20223
  CABRILLO LANE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 (APN 7055-017-002).*

  Resolution No. 2026-6: A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
  RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE PRECISE PLAN
  2026-1 FOR A DEVELOPMENT PROPOSAL BY MELIA HOMES INC., TO DEMOLISH TWO
  (2) EXISTING COMMERCIAL BUILDINGS CONNECTED BY A SHARED ROOF AND
  CONSTRUCT THIRTY (30) ATTACHED THREE-STORY TOWNHOME DWELLING UNITS,
  INCLUDING THREE AFFORDABLE UNITS, WITHIN SIX (6) BUILDINGS. THE PROJECT
  ALSO INCLUDES OPEN SPACE AND RECREATION AREAS, PARKING, LANDSCAPING,
  AND ACCESS IMPROVEMENTS ON A ±1.34-ACRE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 20223
  CABRILLO LANE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 (APN 7055-017-002).*

  Resolution No 2026-7: A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
  RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE A REASSIGNMENT
  OF HOUSING UNITS BETWEEN SITE A AND SITE 7 WITHIN THE CITY’S 2021-2029
  HOUSING ELEMENT, IN COMPLIANCE WITH HOUSING ELEMENT PROGRAM 9 AND NO
  NET LOSS PROVISIONS OF APPLICABLE HOUSING LAW.

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVE DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2026-1, A REQUEST TO
  AMEND TITLE 22 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE RELATED TO LOCATION AND
  PERMITTING CRITERIA FOR BODY ART BUSINESSES.*

City of Cerritos  February 4, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 3
   *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Associate Planner Mary Balderrama. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details on the historical background of body
  art business regulations in the City and the proposed code amendment to remove
  certain regulations pertaining to the location and permitting criteria that may
  potentially constitute an unconstitutional restriction on free speech and expressive
  conduct.

  Discussion continued regarding the location of the MC-2 zone, the existing
  regulations for body art businesses, and the timeframe for implementation of the
  code amendment.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Jhaveri and seconded by Commissioner
  Chauhan to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-8: A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS
  CITY COUNCIL APPROVE DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2026-1, A REQUEST TO
  AMEND TITLE 22 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE RELATED TO LOCATION AND
  PERMITTING CRITERIA FOR BODY ART BUSINESSES.*

  The motion carried (4-0-0-1) as follows:

  AYES:  Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  Ao

7.  New & Old

7A.  Review and consideration of an informational report to the Cerritos Planning
  Commission providing an overview of the City of Cerritos 2025 General Plan Annual
  Progress Report for submittal to the California Governor's Office of Land Use and
  Climate Innovation (LCI) and the California Department of Housing and Community
  Development (HCD).

  A staff report was given by Associate Planner Mary Balderrama. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details about the City of Cerritos General Plan
  and the 2025 General Plan Annual Progress Report (APR). The presentation detailed
  the implementation status of programs with the City’s General Plan, including the
  Housing, Growth Management, Community design, and Land Use Elements. Ms.
  Balderrama concluded her presentation, recommending that the Planning
  Commission review and discuss the information provided, and receive and file this
  report.

  Discussion continued regarding the status of completed permits issued, the City's
  economic development, growth management, and the number of code enforcement
  violations.

City of Cerritos  February 4, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 4
   Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no other speakers
  wishing to address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

8.  Reports

8A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  There were no reports from the Designated Commission Liaison to the Planning
  Commission.

8B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Chauhan and Chair Reyes.

9.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:41 p.m.

  /s/Amanda Acuña
  Amanda Acuña
  Secretary to the Planning Commission

Attest:

/s/Jose “Armin” Reyes
Jose “Armin” Reyes
Chair

Approved: March 4, 2026

City of Cerritos  February 4, 2026
